Name: JP's Early Trinkets - Trinkets from the Start

Description:
[center][b][color=#00ff00][size=6][font=Georgia][i][u]Early Trinkets[/u][/i][/font][/size][/color][/b][/center]


[b][font=Georgia][color=#ff00ff][size=5][i]I don't know anything about fighting monsters, but I have these awesome Trinkets![/i][/size][/color][/font][/b]


[size=4][font=Georgia]There's not much to say, [color=#00ffff]unlock the Trinket Slot and the Trinket spawn right from the start of the game without having to reach Combat Mastery. [/color][/font][/size]
[font=Georgia][size=4][b]It only modifies one game statistic, so the mod is compatible with any nuclear or hydrogen bomb you install in your game.[/b][/size][/font]


[b][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=5]There are no settings or anything else to translate. [/size][/color][/font][/b]
